name: Serious Rattlesnake 31
author: Sujanthapast0
description: Rounded light orange button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-10px), box-shadow becomes 0px 7px 1px #000000, border becomes 1px solid #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Serious Rattlesnake 31</title>
<style>
/* Serious Rattlesnake 31 by Sujanthapast0 — https://uiverse.io/Sujanthapast0/serious-rattlesnake-31 */
button {
  border: 1px solid black;
  padding: 12px 30px 12px 30px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  background-color: #fdceb6;
  font-weight: bolder;
  font-size: 15px;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 1px;
  transform: all 2s esase;
  transition-duration: .3s;
}

button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  box-shadow: 0px 7px 1px rgb(0, 0, 0);
  border: 1px solid black;
}

button:active {
  transform: translateY(10px);
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 1px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
